```parts
part rigid impact pendulum
  needs  pivot height
  needs  length
  needs  bob radius
  needs  bob mass
  needs  rod mass
  needs  damping

  pivot
    is a  point
    at    pivot height up

  bob
    is a           sphere bob radius radius, bob mass
    length below pivot
    turns on       pendulum hinge, about y, at pivot
    swings         −90° to 90°
    damping        damping
    starts turned  0°

  rod
    is a         rod 4 mm thick, from pivot to bob's top
    weighs       rod mass
    attached to  bob
```

-- The tilted lever and its ball retainer approximate the launching stage;
